title: StewardMD MaiK Knowledge Source Manifest
description: Declares every knowledge source the MaiK assistant is grounded on, its lawful-use status, and how it participates. Governance artifact: enforces paraphrase-only use (no verbatim reproduction of copyrighted text) and the ICMR ▸ international-guideline ▸ Harrison treatment precedence. No source TEXT is stored here - only provenance metadata.

updated.description: ISO date of last manifest review

paraphraseOnly.description: All derived content is paraphrased/structured, never copied verbatim.

noPaywalledIngestion.description: No bulk ingestion of copyrighted/paywalled full text into the KB.

citationRequired.description: Every clinical claim carries a source ref + page/section anchor.

engineAuthority.description: The deterministic StewardMD engine - not any source or the LLM - owns diagnosis, confidence, and stewardship recommendations.

treatmentPrecedence.description: Order in which treatment sources win when they conflict (highest first).

usage.description: How the source is used. Nothing is stored verbatim.

role.description: What this source grounds in the assistant (disease reference / treatment protocol / dosing / stewardship / severity criteria).

precedenceTier.description: Which tier of treatmentPrecedence this source maps to (null for non-treatment sources).

verbatimStored.description: MUST be false - no verbatim copyrighted text is stored.

citationAnchor.description: Form of the citation shown/kept (e.g. page range, guideline name).

clinicianFacingLabel.description: How this source is labelled to clinicians in the UI (never a proprietary title where inappropriate).

examples.description: Representative guideline names grouped under this source (metadata only).
